positions.title: Senior Software Development Manager
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented system’s core interface-management/communication process and messaging pipeline with ZeroMQ and Python3.4.
- Responsible for profiling and communicating behavior of performance critical system components. Participated in rewrites of components in C and wrote shim layers between performant rewritten code and less-critical system modules.
- Developed distributed framework for profiling system behavior using source-level hooks. Framework generated models of prospective customers’ use-cases and ran simulations over distributed/clustered systems. From a server running on each instrumented node, metrics were streamed back to a client in realtime, compiled in csv formats for visualization, and models were reusable for comparing changes in product software.
- Aided in the design and construction of AWS S3-compatible REST storage service and endpoint for exposing filesystem mounts utilizing Boost.Beast HTTP & Websocket on Boost.Asio in C++11.
- Along with DevOps, maintained system configuration for products consisting of Nginx, systemd service units, firewall rules, installer scripts, simple Docker containerization, etc.
- Assisted in customer installs and on-call rotations for escelated product support cases.
- Defined company-wide Git development workflow for development and release.

positions.title: Embedded Linux Developer (remote consulting)
positions.description:
As a part of this consulting position, I:
 - Took existing, non-functional, undocumented, non-version controlled C++ and Qt application source code and compiled it with dependencies on an embedded system (Raspberry Pi).  
-  Cleaned code sources and pushed into a Git repository
 - Implemented fixes and improvements to Qt GUI touchscreen application interfacing with many physical locking devices over USB to serial converter
 - Added support and special behavior for physical security devices such as magnetic stripe cards, HID proximity cards, and fingerprint scanners.

positions.title: Embedded Linux Kernel Developer (remote consulting)
positions.description:
As a part of completing this short contract position, I:
- Implemented Linux driver for Raspberry Pi add-on soundcard
- Debugged kernel, patch submitted and merged into official Linux tree for existing ALSA SoC codec
- Defined device tree overlay for new hardware to be included in Raspbian distribution
- Performed basic debugging of circuit and logic signals (I2C)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented core system components for building flagship product features, including: 
- Generic file-storage service reused throughout product by feature teams, easily extended using swappable backends to third party storage and cloud services (AWS S3, EMC Atmos, etc.)
-  Distributed backup service that automated system fail-over and proximity-based serving of files based on user's geographical location
- Migration service for moving files and files' metadata belonging to legacy product into current flagship product
- Ported central database request server from Python to Go, gathered performance and stability metrics for comparison
- Monitoring services and scripts for identifying and reporting unexpected system behavior
- Load balancing configuration for NGINX

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Sync (Software Developer, June 2011 – September 2013) 
-    Constructed and aided in the general design of an enterprise-class server platform and accompanying REST API, facilitating data synchronization and caching capabilities between a host controller and many concurrent desktop clients.  Persistence layer released under the LGPLv2.1.
-    Within a team of four, implemented features in Python, PHP, JavaScript, and Bash using MySQL replication, TokyoCabinet, Memcached, Twistd, OpenVPN, and a home-baked general object persistence layer.  (https://github.com/accellion/gobpersist).
-    Responsible for tuning Apache web server, maintaining system for optimum performance and resource consumption as new features are added.

Secure Collaboration (Software Developer, July 2011- March 2012)
-    With two other engineers, profiled behavior of a secure file transfer appliance and its interaction with other server platforms under different load scenarios. Successfully identified performance issues and scaling possibilities after one week of on-site testing with product team in Singapore.  Increased system throughput by 25%.
-    Working within a team of twenty engineers distributed between Palo Alto and Singapore, aided in the implementation of new backend features and general bug-fixes using Perl, PHP, JavaScript, and jQuery using Rally and Jira to track our Agile development processes.
